items.html: Also you must know that at first the Mochin of ZA of Yenika were from the side of Ima and from the side of Aba, as is known. And behold, those same Mochin, which are the KHB of ZA, are divided into articles, as mentioned, also when the Mochin of Gadlut come; and it is found that when the VAK of Gadlut came, four articles rose in the Chesed of ZA from the side of the Mochin of the Katnut of Ima, and four articles from the side of the Mochin of Aba; and in this same manner all the rest.
